reason: RelayLoom is an external DingTalk Stream chat relay for DeepSeek Harness agents, with allowlisted sessions, asynchronous ACK-first replies, deduplication, and bounded approval handling; live tenant transport remains unverified.

summaries.zh: RelayLoom 将钉钉 Stream 消息中继到 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，并支持白名单会话、ACK 优先回复和受约束的审批命令。
summaries.en: RelayLoom relays DingTalk Stream messages to DeepSeek Harness agents with allowlisted sessions, ACK-first replies, and bounded approval commands.

capabilities: Creates and resumes DeepSeek Harness agent sessions
Processes sender- and conversation-bound approval commands
Reads DingTalk credentials from named environment variables
Makes opt-in external network requests to DingTalk
